criteria.description: Coherence with prefix: continuation grammatically completes 'А вы когда-нибудь пробовали хотбокс с ' with a plausible object/complement and together forms a single coherent tweet, without repeating the prefix.

Voice and stance preservation: continuation stays in informal conversational Russian, matches the casual provocative tone of the prompt, does not add links, invented hashtags, or meta-explanations about the task; informality, lowercase, '..', slashes, fragments and nonstandard spelling are acceptable if they fit the voice.

Specificity vs generic hyperbole: reward a distinctive concrete image, detail, or joke; penalize stock generic phrasing like 'один из самых ужасных опытов' / 'никогда больше lol' / 'one of the most miserable experiences ever' as weak voice - such generic hyperbole caps naturalness unless accompanied by something distinctive.
Economy and length: continuation is about 17 words (acceptable roughly 12-22) and the full tweet with prefix fits within 280 characters; no filler or generic polish to inflate length.
